[LSER.8.7.2] The only cross-tier visibility for series data is
via `persist:` ([LSER.8.3]). The integrator's storage callback
wiring decides whether persisted samples are visible across
tiers — sharing a samples-plane backend across tiers makes
the data visible; per-tier storage keeps it local. libds
takes no position; the choice is integrator territory per
[LSTO].
